name: zeitwide-edge
description: Cloudflare Worker in front of zeitwide.com: Markdown negotiation, bot labels, telemetry, AI referral tags.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.seed-ranges: esbuild scripts/seed-ranges.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/seed-ranges.mjs && node dist/seed-ranges.mjs dist/ranges-bulk.json && wrangler kv bulk put dist/ranges-bulk.json --remote --namespace-id
